answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and shared evidence: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to the swarm’s capital loss, so splitting stake across aliases cannot reduce expected cost. In this sonnet of incentives, the cipher is common-liability accounting, not a fable of independent actors.
